Record Class ReportRepository.ItemSales

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.squad93.pos.db.ReportRepository.ItemSales
Record Components:
menuItemId - menu item identifier
itemName - menu item display name
unitsSold - number of drinks sold
drinkRevenue - revenue from stored drink base prices
toppingRevenue - revenue from stored extra-topping prices
Enclosing class:
ReportRepository
public static record ReportRepository.ItemSales(int menuItemId, String itemName, long unitsSold, BigDecimal drinkRevenue, BigDecimal toppingRevenue) extends Record
Sales of one menu item with drink and topping revenue kept separately.
